theme: Trao đổi với kế toán thuế

vocab.example: We need to prepare everything before the tax deadline next week.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta cần chuẩn bị mọi thứ trước hạn nộp thuế tuần sau.

vocab.meaning_vi: giấy tờ, chứng từ bổ sung
vocab.example: Please send the backup paperwork before Friday so I can finish the filing.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng gửi giấy tờ bổ sung trước thứ Sáu để tôi hoàn tất việc nộp thuế.

vocab.example: Health insurance contributions can count as a tax deduction.
vocab.example_vi: Tiền đóng bảo hiểm y tế có thể được tính là khoản khấu trừ thuế.

vocab.example: Are we eligible for any tax exemption this quarter?
vocab.example_vi: Quý này chúng ta có được miễn thuế khoản nào không?

vocab.example: We must submit the annual tax report before the deadline.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng ta phải nộp báo cáo thuế hàng năm trước hạn.

vocab.example: There's a penalty for late filing, so let's submit early.
vocab.example_vi: Có mức phạt cho việc nộp trễ, vì vậy hãy nộp sớm.

vocab.example: Can you clarify a regulation about employee tax deductions?
vocab.example_vi: Anh có thể làm rõ giúp một quy định về khấu trừ thuế nhân viên không?

vocab.example: Please send the invoices so I can finalize the numbers.
vocab.example_vi: Vui lòng gửi hóa đơn để tôi chốt số liệu cuối cùng.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Finance Staff)
lines.text: Hi Kien, thanks for coming. We need to prepare for the tax deadline next week.

lines.speaker: Kien (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: No problem. Do you have all the backup paperwork ready?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Finance Staff)
lines.text: Most of them. I'm still missing two invoices from last month.

lines.speaker: Kien (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: Okay, please send them to me by Wednesday so I can finalize the numbers.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Finance Staff)
lines.text: Sure. Can you also clarify a regulation about employee tax deductions?

lines.speaker: Kien (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: Of course. Which tax deduction are you asking about?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Finance Staff)
lines.text: The one for health insurance contributions.

lines.speaker: Kien (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: I'll check the latest rule and explain it in our next call.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Finance Staff)
lines.text: Great. Also, are we eligible for any tax exemption this quarter?

lines.speaker: Kien (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: I checked, and part of it qualifies. Just remember there's a penalty for late filing, so let's submit early.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Finance Staff)
lines.text: Understood. I don't want to submit the annual tax report late again.

lines.speaker: Kien (Tax Consultant)
lines.text: Don't worry, we still have time. I'll send you the draft tomorrow.

questions.q: What does Hoa ask Kien to clarify?
options: A regulation about employee tax deductions

questions.q: Why does Kien say they should submit early?
options: There's a penalty for late filing
